source.source_article: No source article; fictional tutorial example
authorized_normalizations: None; the materials were written specifically for this tutorial.

population.simulation_target: Adult employee evaluating a manager's change announcement

materials.participant_role: Act as one employee reading a manager's announcement. Use your own judgment and do not analyze the experiment.
materials.common_scenario: Your organization is introducing a new internal scheduling system next month. You receive the following message from your manager.

directive_message.label: Directive announcement
directive_message.stimulus: The scheduling system has been selected. All employees must begin using it next month. Detailed instructions will follow.

participative_message.label: Participative announcement
participative_message.stimulus: The scheduling system has been selected. Before implementation next month, employees are invited to suggest how the rollout and training should be organized.

materials.response_instruction: Rate each statement from 1 (strongly disagree) to 7 (strongly agree) and return only integer item responses in the required JSON structure.

items.text: I would support implementing this scheduling system.
I would be willing to invest effort in learning this scheduling system.

research_restricted.aligned_hypothesis_text: The participative message increases employee support relative to the directive message.
research_restricted.reversed_hypothesis_text: The directive message increases employee support relative to the participative message.
